headline: How Musharraf's rule fell despite November 3 'emergency'
subheadline: His nine-year rule ended despite emergency rule, media and judicial controls, and a ban on political activities
author: Mazhar Abbas
article_text:
How could a powerful ruler not protect his own government despite imposing an ‘emergency’ 19 years ago, on this very day, November 3, 2007? He had not only usurped the superior judiciary but also banned top TV programme anchors and political activities. It was not an ‘emergency-plus’ but rather a ‘coup-plus’, as no ruler who had come to power by removing an elected prime minister had ever before tried to save his rule through another extraordinary action.

But, on the same night the then powerful Supreme Court’s seven-member bench declared his order as ‘extra-constitutional’. Here is the inside story of how Musharraf planned to remain in power for another 10 years but the year actually turned out to be fatal for his powerful rule.

Some well-connected sources close to the late Gen Pervez Musharraf revealed that a ‘secret report’ submitted to him in January 2007 made him ‘overconfident’ and a bit arrogant. The report, based on a ‘survey’, revealed that some of his actions and decisions had pushed his popularity rating to 70 per cent.

Five major decisions and actions contributed to his fall despite the imposition of emergency. First, he sacked former chief justice of Pakistan Iftikhar Muhammad Chaudhry on March 9, 2007. Second, the May 12 bloodshed in Karachi, which occurred in an attempt to stop the deposed CJP’s procession. Third, the Lal Masjid operation, which led to a rise in suicide bombings across Pakistan. Fourth, he ignored American advice against imposing emergency, as doing so could jeopardise the deal with former prime minister Benazir Bhutto. Finally, he had not the slightest idea that he was losing popularity even among his own ‘constituency’, as he was kept in the dark about ground realities.

The January report had also suggested that, in order to prolong his rule at least until 2017, Musharraf should mend fences with one of the two popular parties, namely the Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP). His then ally, the Pakistan Muslim League-Quaid (PML-Q), had failed to meet expectations and could not weaken his arch-rival, the Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz (PML-N), led by deposed prime minister Nawaz Sharif. At the time, Nawaz was in Saudi Arabia under a 10-year deal with the Musharraf government, which had sent him into exile after former president Rafiq Tarrar condoned his life imprisonment.

The myth of 70 per cent popularity was not different from 2001 ‘referendum’ like Gen Zia-ul-Haq’s 1984 referendum which these ‘military ruler’s won by over 90 per cent against the ground realities.

What followed the January report was the first ‘secret meeting’ outside Pakistan between President Musharraf and former prime minister Benazir Bhutto. Sources said Musharraf ignored suggestions from some of his colleagues that he should at least take PML-Q leader Chaudhry Shujaat Hussain into his confidence. Interestingly, the meeting took place months after Benazir and Nawaz had signed the Charter of Democracy (CoD), an accord that had made the then ruling elite nervous.

The meeting was just the beginning of the final agreement under the National Reconciliation Ordinance (NRO), under which all cases against former president Asif Ali Zardari and other political opponents were to be withdrawn. However, the NRO arrangement was subject to a condition that Benazir would not return to Pakistan before the general elections, which were scheduled for December 2007 but were later postponed to early 2008 following her assassination.

Gen Musharraf and Benazir’s ‘deal’ fell apart after he surprised her by imposing emergency rule in the country, following a series of Supreme Court decisions that he perceived as threatening his position. The move was followed by another Provisional Constitution Order (PCO) for judges, resulting in the removal of CJP Iftikhar Chaudhry, who had been restored by the apex court in July 2007 after it declared Musharraf’s March 9, 2007, action against him “illegal and unconstitutional”.

A very well-connected source close to Musharraf said, “Surprisingly, the former president even ignored the advice of an American official not to impose an emergency, which the official said would not be acceptable to Benazir Bhutto.”

Earlier, following the January report and his meeting with Benazir, some of Musharraf’s actions showed signs of overconfidence and arrogance. One such action was the sacking of sitting Chief Justice Iftikhar Chaudhry. The latter’s refusal to follow the president’s ‘order’ to quit as CJP triggered a countrywide lawyers’ movement. Strangely, even some sitting Supreme Court judges attended an anti-Musharraf convention organised in support of the deposed CJP. “It was clear that all was not well within Musharraf’s own powerful constituency, but he thought otherwise,” the source disclosed.

The sources said Musharraf and some of his close aides were confident that the Supreme Court would not reinstate the former CJP, and that an intelligence report had also suggested the same outcome. However, in July 2007, the apex court unanimously ruled in favour of the deposed chief justice and reinstated him. It was a shocking verdict for Gen Musharraf and perhaps marked the beginning of the end of his otherwise powerful nine-year rule.

The March 9 action by Musharraf was followed by the May 12 violence in Karachi, when nearly 80 people were killed in an attempt to stop Iftikhar Chaudhry’s procession. That same evening, Musharraf made a ‘victory sign’, appearing to celebrate the action. Even then, he failed to realise that some people within his own inner circle did not support his actions.

Some other factors that ultimately contributed to his downfall included his visit to Agra, India, where he had almost agreed to sign an accord with the then Indian prime minister.

The sources disclosed that two or three days before the imposition of emergency, the former president had sought their views on the possibility of declaring one. “I opposed it, and some of his close political allies were also against any harsh action. However, a few backed him and supported measures such as imposing emergency rule and banning the media,” one of the sources said.

So, what actually followed November 3? First, Benazir Bhutto, who had returned to Dubai after the suicide attack on her procession on October 18, 2007, in which more than 200 people were killed, returned to Pakistan after the declaration of emergency. She accused Musharraf and some of his close aides of trying to kill her. She was assassinated less than two months later, on December 27, 2007. These developments weakened the country's most powerful military ruler. Musharraf stepped down as army chief and was replaced by Gen Ashfaq Parvez Kayani. The army subsequently announced that it would remain ‘neutral’ in the 2008 elections. Finally, President Musharraf decided to step down, perhaps against his own will, as was evident from his ‘farewell’ speech.

So, 2007 proved fatal to his otherwise smooth nine-year rule, as even emergency rule, control over the media and judiciary, and a ban on political activities could not save his regime.

The writer is a columnist and analyst of Geo, Jang and The News. He can be reached on X at @MazharAbbsGEO

headline: Harriet Phillips grateful for Princess Anne's gesture after painful time
subheadline: Princess Anne's daughter-in-law reveals humble move King's sister made for family
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Princess Anne’s new daughter-in-law Harriet Phillips is understood to be grateful for what the royal has done for the family.

Peter Phillips, Anne’s only son, had married Harriet during the summer in an intimate wedding, and also welcomed 14-year-old Georgina into the fold.

It is hard for a young teen to settle into a new environment and Harriet was undoubtedly worried about how things would pan out.

READ MORE: Princess Anne makes heartfelt gesture for Harriet's daughter

However, her tensions were eased after Anne and members of the royal family made a warm gesture for Georgina.

In her latest interview with Hello!, Harriet had revealed her “painful” challenge of raising her only daughter as a single mum. The mum and daughter share a very close bond, hence the delightful welcome was a relief to her.

“Although at times it was a painful experience, I did have the support of people who loved us,” she added. “Any time in life when you're under pressure or facing adversity, something good always comes from it. Lean in; don't be scared.”

Harriet proudly divulged on how her daughter adapted to the unusual situation.

“She’s very serene and emotionally very mature. She takes it all in her stride,” the mum said.

This comes after it was revealed that Anne is “so happy” for her son and “overjoyed” to have another granddaughter.

Moreover, sources said both Savannah and Isla “adore” their stepsister and the “trio have become quite a force to be reckoned with”.

headline: Measles outbreak turns deadly in New York for first time in 30 years: details inside
subheadline: So far in 2026, New York has reported 178 measles cases, 170 outside of NYC, per the New York Department of Health
author: Web Desk
article_text:
New York State has reported its first measles death in more than 30 years, NY State health officials confirmed on Monday, November 2, 2026.

A child in a rural county in northern New York died.

“We are deeply saddened by the death of a child in Lewis County associated with the ongoing measles outbreak,” part of a statement from state health officials read.

However, the statement did not provide additional details about the child.

So far in 2026, 178 measles cases have been reported in New York, according to the New York Department of Health.

Most of the cases, around 170, were reported outside of New York City.

Fifteen cases have been reported in Lewis County.

Reports suggest, in the neighbouring Pennsylvania, state health officials are scrambling to fight the outbreak that hit New York in more than 30 years.

As of Monday, 1,433 cases of measles have been reported including 269 hospitalisations, with six dead, according to the Pennsylvania Health Department.

Whereas, as per the latest figures released by the Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, the total number of measles cases has reached 4,852.

Queen Mary has been struggling behind the scenes following the loss of her loved ones and backlash from the public due to alleged cosmetic surgery.

In conversation with Danish newspaper Borneavisen, the 54-year-old royal opened up about how she felt alone when she moved to Denmark.

headline: Savannah Chrisley's pregnancy brings an unexpected wedding twist
subheadline: Savannah Chrisley reveals why her wedding was pushed back
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Savannah Chrisley has already said “I do” — and apparently, her baby had other plans for the big wedding celebration.

The Chrisley Knows Best alum revealed that she secretly married businessman Jason Galanis in the Cayman Islands in July, months before sharing news of her pregnancy.

The surprise confession came during the November 1 premiere of Golden Tate’s The Golden Ticket YouTube series.

Read More: Savannah Chrisley fries back at critics after pregnancy reveal

"We ended up getting married in the Cayman Islands in July," Savannah said. "We did everything there, but we haven't filed it here—or else then it would be public record."

The couple still plans to celebrate with a larger ceremony, but guests will have to wait a little longer. Their January 2027 wedding has been moved to May, thanks to one very tiny guest already on the way.

"Wedding is in May," she shared, "because wedding was supposed to be in January, and then I have a real life wedding crasher. So [that's] the way that worked out."

At 29, Savannah is also embracing the idea of motherhood, describing her pregnancy as "such a gift."

She admitted that pregnancy isn't always comfortable, but feeling her baby kick makes the experience worthwhile.

She also spoke about the chance to raise a child with values that could make a positive difference in the world.

Savannah previously shared an emotional tribute to Jason when announcing their engagement and pregnancy, calling him her protector, fiercest fighter and safe place.

Read More: Who is Savannah Chrisley's boyfriend Jason? Here's complete relationship timeline

So, the marriage is official between them, the baby is on the way, and the party is simply waiting for May.

article_text:
Meghan Markle has received yet another upsetting update, but this time it's not about her family tensions — it's about her career.

The Duchess of Sussex's Netflix show, With Love, Meghan, was not able to win an Emmy Award.

For the unversed, the cooking show was nominated for a 2026 Daytime Emmy Award in the Outstanding Lifestyle Programme category.

READ MORE: Meghan reveals big plans for Princess Lilibet - but Harry says 'no'

However, the trophy went to A Different Breed, which is a show about dogs. The announcement led to fresh criticism of Meghan.

A social media user wrote on X, "She should never have been nominated in the first place.

Another said about the situation, "That is hilarious."

On July 15, Meghan took to her official Instagram page, celebrating the news of the show's nomination.

She wrote, "A huge congratulations to the amazing crew, producers, and team who worked on ‘With Love, Meghan’ on @netflix.

"We are nominated for an Emmy for Outstanding Lifestyle Series!"

READ MORE: Meghan Markle's ‘painful' struggle revealed amid father's police probe

It is important to note that the new career setback came amid the ongoing investigation into child pornography against her father, Thomas Markle.

headline: Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel dies in hospital following on-pitch collision
subheadline: De Miguel was initially treated on the pitch after he suffered a cardiac arrest following a clash late in extra time with Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono during Monday match
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel, who suffered injuries in an on-pitch collision during Monday's match, died a day after he was admitted to hospital.

De Miguel was initially treated on the pitch after he suffered a cardiac arrest following a clash late in extra time with Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono before he was taken to hospital.

The match was cancelled following the collision.

He was 30.

The Spanish club had earlier reported that he was “stable, despite the severity of his condition” in the intensive care unit of Hospital Universitario de Nuestra Senora de Candelaria in Santa Cruz.

The club confirmed his death after his neurological condition had worsened in the early hours of Tuesday, November 3, 2026.

The Spanish second division club issued a statement saying he had passed away at 8 a.m. on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, adding, “Heartbroken, with a lump in our throats and unable to believe this is true, we at CD Tenerife announce the tragic passing of Jesus de Miguel Alameda.”

The score was 2-2: De Miguel was played through on goal, with keeper Owono rushing out and colliding with him, striking his chest.

Owono was awarded a straight red card for the challenge and dashed to his side immediately, with De Miguel appearing motionless.

headline: Pakistan offers Bangladesh expertise in managing energy crisis amid Mideast conflict
subheadline: Ali Pervaiz Malik, Bangladeshi adviser discuss strategies to ensure uninterrupted fuel supplies, per statement
author: Business Desk
article_text:
Petroleum Minister meets Bangladeshi adviser in Islamabad.
Both sides discuss strategies to manage energy crisis.
Rashed Al Mahmud hails Pak's efforts to secure LNG cargoes.

Pakistan has offered support to Bangladesh in dealing with the ongoing energy crisis triggered by the Middle East conflict and the subsequent closure of the Strait of Hormuz — a key oil trade route from which around one-fifth of global oil shipments pass.

The development came as Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik held a meeting with Adviser on Finance of Bangladesh Rashed Al Mahmud Titumir in Islamabad to exchange views on the evolving global energy situation, its impact on international energy markets, and the measures taken by both countries to address energy supply challenges.

According to a statement issued by the Pakistan High Commission in Bangladesh on Tuesday, both sides discussed their respective strategies for managing the unprecedented energy crisis, ensuring uninterrupted fuel supplies and mitigating the impact of rising energy market uncertainties on their economies.

The petroleum minister briefed the Bangladeshi adviser on Pakistan's efforts to secure fuel supplies amid challenging global circumstances.

He also shared details of the government's initiatives, including targeted fuel subsidy measures, to provide relief to the public while managing the impact of the crisis.

Al Mahmud Titumir shared the steps taken by Bangladesh to ensure fuel supply security and manage the emerging challenges.

He observed that the current crisis had brought energy security to the forefront of policymaking, highlighting the need to make it a central consideration in national energy strategies.

The Bangladeshi official also emphasised the importance of diversifying energy sources and supply routes to strengthen resilience against global disruptions.

He appreciated Pakistan's diplomatic efforts towards de-escalation of the conflict involving Iran, stressing that de-escalation was essential for global economic stability, as the crisis was affecting economies and energy markets worldwide. The adviser also commended Pakistan's efforts to secure LNG cargoes from Qatar through the Strait of Hormuz despite the challenging circumstances.

Petroleum Minister Malik termed the situation an unprecedented energy crisis, underscoring the importance of preparedness, diversification and regional cooperation in navigating global energy disruptions.

“He expressed Pakistan's willingness to share its experiences and lessons with Bangladesh to support their efforts in managing the energy crisis and strengthening energy security,” read the statement.

Both sides underscored the importance of continued engagement and sharing of experiences to address common energy challenges and build greater resilience against future global supply disruptions, it added.

headline: George, Charlotte, Louis mark secret celebration as Archie, Lilibet return
subheadline: Prince William, Princess Kate's children uphold family tradition with special gesture
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Prince William and Princess Catherine hinted at a special celebration that took place in their Windsor home, Forest Lodge, especially as all children united during half-term break.

Schools in UK have been closed for vacation since last week and will resume next week. Hence, Prince George had been home for the spooky holiday at home.

In a recent update from the Prince and Princess of Wales, it was revealed that the Waleses had marked Hallowe’en together, with an adorable throwback photo of a one-year-old Louis.

READ MORE: Prince William takes over for King Charles as Firm prepares for bombshell

It is no secret that the Waleses have a very close-knit relation with the Middletons, hence, their granny Carole Middleton possibly inspired her grandchildren to embrace a family tradition.

Pumpkin carving is a annual event in the Middleton household, as Carole dubbed it as a “autumn highlight” in one of her interviews in 2022.

She shared how she looks forward to decorating pumpkins with her “loved ones”.

This is also something the Wales children share in common with their two cousins, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet.

As reports revealed that the Sussex family has now moved into their new home in Cotswold following ahead of their vacation.

While the children love trick' o treating, carving pumpkins is also considered a fun activity in the Sussex household as Meghan has shared glimpses of her children celebrating the spooky season with the fun activity.

Last year, in Montecito, Archie and Lilibet visit a pumpkin farm with their grandmother. This year, things may have been different in their new home, but some family traditions are carried regardless of the location.

headline: Suki Waterhouse makes rare statement about Bradley Cooper romance
subheadline: Suki Waterhouse shares why her romance with Robert Pattinson feels different
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Suki Waterhouse has offered a rare glimpse into her past romance with Bradley Cooper.

The romance sounds like her relationship with Robert Pattinson has completely changed her expectations of love.

In a recent interview with The Sunday Times, the singer and actress reflected on nearly a decade with Pattinson, admitting that keeping a relationship strong while juggling demanding careers and constant travel takes work.

Read More: Suki Waterhouse addresses rumours she secretly married Robert Pattinson

“It’s quite hard to make something work where you’re both doing these kinds of jobs, when you don’t live in one place and you’re traveling a lot,” she said.

Still, the couple's connection has stood the test of time. “It is almost a decade [of our relationship] and that is a beautiful thing,” Waterhouse added.

“It’s a thing that I go, I can’t believe that I have this in my life and I can’t believe that I’m so happy.”

The 34-year-old also hinted at why this relationship feels different, recalling that her previous romances rarely made it past the two-year mark.

She dated Cooper from 2013 to 2015 but didn't mention him by name.

“Before I had only ever gone out with someone for two years, and if it was two years, it would have been a disaster at the end,” she said.

Waterhouse previously described that difficult period in a 2024 interview with British Vogue, saying, “It probably has taken a decade to work myself out and actually be able to have this expansion in my life.”

Now engaged to Pattinson, she says the past ultimately brought her somewhere better.

“All these chaotic ways that my life went, it was always material,” she said, adding that it “led me to a love that is really pure.”

Read More: Suki Waterhouse announces 'loveland' tour update with Sombr

The couple, who share a daughter born in March 2024, are also considering a big wedding celebration.

“If we were going to go for it, we’d have a massive party, blow it out,” she revealed.

headline: Learjet60 Florida plane crash: tech boss's last heartfelt post goes viral after death
subheadline: Adam Robinson, 45, died on Sunday when a Learjet 60 plane crashed in Cresthaven, an area located about 9 miles from President Trump’s Mar-a-Lago resort
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Learjet 60 Florida plane crash victim's last heartfelt social media post, highlighting the institution of family, has gone viral.

Adam Robinson, 45, died on Sunday when a Learjet 60 plane crashed in Cresthaven, an area located about 9 miles from President Trump’s Mar-a-Lago resort.

Robinson's post was originally shared on X (formerly Twitter) in April.

In the post, Robinson, the founder of tech start-up Retention, sheds light on corporate life.

“In my 20’s (sic), I used to work on Wall Street,” he wrote while recalling his early days of professional life.

“People my age now (45) said they were working 10, 80, 90 hours a week for their families… but all their families actually wanted was their presence,” he added.

“They didn’t understand why their families resented how much they worked when they lived in a nice house, and their kids went to private schools,” he continued.

“I decided early in my startup journey that wasn’t going to be me.”

“My family life gives me energy for my work. My work gives me energy for my family life,” he concluded the heartfelt post that is connecting with many on social media after his death.

Also aboard the plane were Robinson’s wife, Helen Sharp; their children, four-year-old Emma and two-year-old Charlie; the youngsters’ nanny, Anita Maria Cetina; and another couple named Rachael Reed and Charmi Fehr.

headline: King Charles 'short fuse' could spell trouble for his reign
subheadline: King Charles faces fresh calls to step aside and focus on his health
author: Shehzad Hameed
article_text:
British monarch King Charles III is facing fresh calls to step aside and focus on his health as he continues his brave battle against cancer at an advanced age.

The 77-year-old monarch, who has been courageously fighting cancer, has come under public scrutiny for viral moments showcasing his famously short fuse, most recently during his Caribbean tour and the infamous leaky pen incident shortly after his accession in 2022.

While these outbursts frequently divide public opinion, royal experts note they often make him more relatable rather than permanently turning fans against him.

READ MORE: Queen Camilla reacts to King Charles awkward rain moment

Some royal watchers and critics continue to demand that the monarch leave the throne for Prince William.

These calls have grown louder after the latest incident, in which the King appeared to lose his cool while attending an Independence Day parade in Antigua and Barbuda during a torrential downpour.

Undoubtedly, understanding the sensitivity of the moment, the Queen handled it with far greater efficiency.

Visibly frustrated, the King was filmed gesticulating wildly, throwing his arms in the air, and repeatedly demanding of his aides, "Where's my umbrella?"

A similar angry moment was caught on camera just days after the death of Queen Elizabeth II. Under immense stress, King Charles lost his temper during a signing ceremony at Hillsborough Castle in Northern Ireland.

After writing the wrong date, the fountain pen he was using began leaking ink onto his fingers.

The monarch stood up in anger, handed the pen to Camilla and muttered: "Oh God, I hate this... I can't bear this bloody thing... every stinking time!" before walking out of the room.

The reaction to these moments also splited the public into two camps. Undoubtedly, online critics and anti-monarchy groups often point to them as evidence of a "spoilt" or entitled temper, arguing it reflects poorly on a head of state.

Meanwhile, royal defenders and fans largely view these outbursts as human and relatable. Many note that his 2022 meltdown happened under immense grief and a grueling schedule, while getting drenched in a suit would frustrate anyone.

On the other hand, King Charles has historically managed to win back fans by using self-deprecating humour to mock his own outbursts.

He has repeatedly joked in public speeches about his "vicissitudes faced with frustratingly failing fountain pens," turning what could have been a damaging reputation into a running gag that humanises the monarchy.

The 77-year-old monarch, who has been courageously fighting cancer, has come under public scrutiny for viral moments showcasing his famously short fuse, most recently during his Caribbean tour and the infamous leaky pen incident shortly after his accession in 2022.

While these outbursts frequently divide public opinion, royal experts note they often make him more relatable rather than permanently turning fans against him.

READ MORE: Queen Camilla reacts to King Charles awkward rain moment

Some royal watchers and critics continue to demand that the monarch leave the throne for Prince William.

These calls have grown louder after the latest incident, in which the King appeared to lose his cool while attending an Independence Day parade in Antigua and Barbuda during a torrential downpour.

Undoubtedly, understanding the sensitivity of the moment, the Queen handled it with far greater efficiency.

Visibly frustrated, the King was filmed gesticulating wildly, throwing his arms in the air, and repeatedly demanding of his aides, "Where's my umbrella?"

A similar angry moment was caught on camera just days after the death of Queen Elizabeth II. Under immense stress, King Charles lost his temper during a signing ceremony at Hillsborough Castle in Northern Ireland.

After writing the wrong date, the fountain pen he was using began leaking ink onto his fingers.

The monarch stood up in anger, handed the pen to Camilla and muttered: "Oh God, I hate this... I can't bear this bloody thing... every stinking time!" before walking out of the room.

The reaction to these moments also splited the public into two camps. Undoubtedly, online critics and anti-monarchy groups often point to them as evidence of a "spoilt" or entitled temper, arguing it reflects poorly on a head of state.

Meanwhile, royal defenders and fans largely view these outbursts as human and relatable. Many note that his 2022 meltdown happened under immense grief and a grueling schedule, while getting drenched in a suit would frustrate anyone.

On the other hand, King Charles has historically managed to win back fans by using self-deprecating humour to mock his own outbursts.

He has repeatedly joked in public speeches about his "vicissitudes faced with frustratingly failing fountain pens," turning what could have been a damaging reputation into a running gag that humanises the monarchy.

headline: Harriet Phillips 'pinch-me' moment with King Charles, Queen Camilla
subheadline: King Charles, Queen Camilla make new royal bride emotional
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Princess Anne's daughter-in-law opened up about how she feels seeing King Charles and Queen Camilla joining other guests at her wedding with Peter Phillips.

Harriet Phillips opened up about her new life with the royals in conversation with Hello! Magazine.

She was asked, "How did it feel to arrive at the church amid the world's press, as well as the King and Queen and other senior royals?"

READ MORE: Harriet Phillips shuts down Meghan's claims about Princess Kate

Harriet called the press and media attention a "background noise." She said that as a bride she enjoyed her big day.

"Of course, you're aware that people are around you, but I really wanted to enjoy it and be present. I was so happy. That's very natural for me. I was peaceful. I prayed. Maybe the peace of God came over me," she added.

Talking about seeing the King and Queen, Harriet said that it was a bit of a "pinch-me" moment but just "incredible."

She shared, "I can't really put it into words. It was just so special. I was close to crying, but I held it together.

READ MORE: Princess Anne family gets big boost as daughter-in-law lands noble role

"There's nothing like a wedding day, because everyone's there for you and you're there for love. It was the happiest day of my life, apart from when my daughter was born."

headline: Olivia Rodrigo surprises fans with new music announcement amid tour
subheadline: Olivia Rodrigo reveals early Christmas present for fans as third album becomes huge success
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Olivia Rodrigo has brought the holiday spirit to fans already with the announcement of her upcoming Christmas song.

The 23-year-old pop superstar took to social media and penned, "my first Christmas song 'take me home (4 christmas)' is out this Thursday at 5 pm pt/ 8 pm ET!! you can preorder it now. im so excited!!!"

The drop dead hitmaker dropped the surprise news amid her ongoing The Unraveled Tour which fans are terribly excited for - whether they are able to attend or watch videos on social media.

READ MORE: Olivia Rodrigo shows love to Phoebe Bridgers at Lost Tour amid her own tour

As soon as the news was out, fans flocked to the comments and wrote, "i’m so freaking excited," and "This is the best Christmas gift ever!! Thank you so much!! You are unreal."

A third chimed in, "Mother coming to save christmas," and "HYPED FOR YOUR FIRST CHRISTMAS SONG QUEEN," wrote another.

While more gushed, "We will all be streaming and spamming all December long mother," and "merry livmas."

headline: King Charles lets slip golden chance in bad bargain: ‘Don't wake me up'
subheadline: King Charles receives disappointng news about key deal as results come in
author: Web Desk
article_text:
King Charles would surely be regretting a decision he had to make months prior to the big news he received from Australia.

The royal family are known for their love of horse racing and Charles, in particular, is fond of the tradition. However, the monarch missed an opportunity for the win after letting go of key asset.

During the 166th staging of the Melbourne Cup, Point of Law, a horse previously owned by King Charles, won the race.

READ MORE: Buckingham Palace shares update from King, Queen as Sussexes make big move

Australian jockey Ethan Brown, who rode the horse to victory, exclaimed, “Don't wake me up, this is every jockey’s dream.”

It is believed that the horse was sold in August this year to top Australian trainer Ciaron Maher ahead of the spring carnival. According to The Australian, the final sale price was “well north of $3 million”.

The three-year-old colt proved itself to be worth a lot more as he reeled in Royal Supremacy for a win on just his sixth career start.

The new owners of the young race horse are expected to pocket a massive seven-sum figure.

However, Charles could not continue keeping Point of Low as the King was unable to have racehorses shared with other owners. Hence, he agreed to part ways.

READ MORE: Prince William takes over for King Charles as Firm prepares for bombshell

headline: Paris Jackson demands huge payout after 17 years of waiting
subheadline: Paris Jackson shares plan have not gone ahead as expected
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Paris Jackson has gone to court over her late father Michael Jackson's money, saying she and her two brothers have waited long enough to receive the money he left for them.

The singer's daughter wants a judge to order his estate to move £447 million into a family trust created for the three children.

She says the trust has still not received its full funding even though Michael's estate has made billions of pounds since his death in 2009.

Under the original plan, Michael's kids were meant to receive money from the trust as they grew older. They, however, were also supposed to get more of their share when they reached the ages of 30, 35 and 40.

READ MORE: Paris Jackson opens up about secret engagement

Paris, moreover, added that these plans have not gone ahead as expected.

Her lawyers believe the estate has enough money to make the payment. They point to several big deals, including the sale of music rights and Neverland Ranch.

But the estate has pushed back against her claims. Its representatives say money cannot be fully moved into the trust until some legal matters, including a tax dispute with the US government, are settled.

The court is expected to hear Paris' request on December 4.

Paris Jackson has gone to court over her late father Michael Jackson's money, saying she and her two brothers have waited long enough to receive the money he left for them.

The singer's daughter wants a judge to order his estate to move £447 million into a family trust created for the three children.

She says the trust has still not received its full funding even though Michael's estate has made billions of pounds since his death in 2009.

Under the original plan, Michael's kids were meant to receive money from the trust as they grew older. They, however, were also supposed to get more of their share when they reached the ages of 30, 35 and 40.

READ MORE: Paris Jackson opens up about secret engagement

Paris, moreover, added that these plans have not gone ahead as expected.

Her lawyers believe the estate has enough money to make the payment. They point to several big deals, including the sale of music rights and Neverland Ranch.

But the estate has pushed back against her claims. Its representatives say money cannot be fully moved into the trust until some legal matters, including a tax dispute with the US government, are settled.

The court is expected to hear Paris' request on December 4.

headline: GTA 6: self-made millionaire explains how to save $5,000 playing Rockstar title
subheadline: Rockstar Games has set November 19 as the official release date for GTA 6
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Grand Theft Auto VI is just two weeks away from its much anticipated release, expected to set new benchmarks for open-world titles.

GTA 6 community has long waited roughly 13 years for this moment to immerse themselves in the fictional U.S. state of Leonida, where the Rockstar title is set.

Mark Tilbury, a British multi-millionaire and content creator, shares startup insights with his more than 9.3 million YouTube subscribers.

He now comes out with a new video explaining how buying GTA 6 can save consumers an estimated $5,000.

In a 30-second video, Tilbury offers some serious business advice.

According to Tilbury, Rockstar Games’ latest title, which is priced at $99.99, is an investment in purchasing GTA 6 that could end up money well spent.

Tilbury went into details explaining like a mathematician how GTA 6 offers at least 80 hours of non-stop entertainment, working out to $1.24 per hour of fun.

On top of the main story, GTA 6 is also packed with side missions, which could contribute to even more hours of entertainment.

Tilbury figures that by taking that into account, GTA 6 offers entertainment at a cost of only 50 cents per hour, far less than concerts, cinema tickets or dining out.

To build an argument for his case, Tilbury divides a consumer’s playing time into 4 hours per night for about 50 evenings’ worth of entertainment.

He then said that going out to a bar at night could easily cost $100 per night, thus saving consumers $5,000 if they stay at home and play GTA 6 instead.

Rockstar Games has set November 19 as the official release date for GTA 6.

headline: Meghan Markle vs Princess Kate: Shocking Palace truth exposed
subheadline: Palace life of the two royal wives, Princess Kate and Meghan Markle
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Princess Kate and Meghan Markle have dominated headlines ever since the Sussexes publicly spoke about their palace ordeal after relocating to the US to live life freely on their own terms.

However, royal commentators, historians and former palace aides have now weighed in on the palace life of the two royal wives.

It has now been revealed that Meghan Markle was never subjected to the same lengthy scrutiny as Catherine, Princess of Wales, before marrying into the royal family.

READ MORE: Who forced Meghan Markle to stay silent?

Insiders suggest the reason was surprisingly simple: nobody wanted to upset Prince Harry.

A palce insider has claimed to Rob Shuter, “The Queen was thrilled Harry had found someone he loved. She saw it as a fresh start, and nobody wanted to jeopardize that happiness.”

Catherine, by contrast, had nearly a decade of dating Prince William before their 2011 wedding. The palace had years to get to know her, her family and her suitability for royal life.

Meghan’s introduction was considerably faster. She met Harry in 2016 and married him less than two years later. And there was another difference: the vetting process.

It won't be wrong to say that Kate patiently earned her place with grace, quiet duty and unwavering loyalty to the Crown, winning the deep respect of the royals and the lasting love of the British public.

It’s an image of dignity and resilience that Meghan, despite her global spotlight, seemingly failed to replicate.

headline: Pakistan tops global YouTube viewership with 96 million users: PTA chairman
subheadline: 150m Pakistanis watch TikTok videos, while 100m accounts are registered on the platform, NA body told
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Pakistan records 560 million daily YouTube video views.
Pakistanis make one billion WhatsApp calls daily.
1.8m people use 5G services in Pakistan: Shaza Fatima.

Pakistan leads the world in YouTube video views, with users watching 560 million videos daily, Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) Chairman Hafeez Ur Rehman told a parliamentary committee on Tuesday.

Briefing the National Assembly Standing Committee on Information Technology, the PTA chief shared figures on the country's social media and messaging platform usage.

He said Pakistan currently has 96 million YouTube users, while 560 million videos were watched daily on the platform, placing the country at the top globally in terms of YouTube viewership.

The PTA chairman further revealed that TikTok has 100 million registered accounts in Pakistan, while 150 million Pakistanis watched videos on the platform.

He added that WhatsApp has 100 million accounts in the country, with users making one billion calls and sending 12 billion messages daily.

Separately, Federal Minister for Information Technology and Telecommunication Shaza Fatima Khawaja told the NA body that social media and artificial intelligence (AI) usage had significantly increased data consumption.

She said no spectrum auction had taken place after former prime minister Nawaz Sharif left office, adding that his government had introduced 4G services, while the incumbent government had conducted a 5G spectrum auction.

The minister said 1.8 million people were using 5G services in Pakistan, adding that the technology was being rolled out in 24 cities and steps were being taken to improve service quality.

Shaza also highlighted several reasons behind disruptions in telecommunications services, including theft of entire mobile towers, diesel and generators.

She said such incidents were among the factors affecting the quality and continuity of telecom services.

headline: Rachel Apa marathon death: Runner dies of rare muscle condition in NYC
subheadline: Father says Rhabdomyolysis killed Rachel Apa during her first marathon
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Rachel Apa, a 24-year-old former college athlete, died Sunday, November 1, after collapsing in Central Park with roughly two miles left in her first New York City Marathon, her family confirmed.

The cause was rhabdomyolysis, a rare and potentially life-threatening muscle condition, as described by her father, Steve Apa.

Apa was a former Division I field hockey player at Bucknell University, had trained for months, and was running with the Parkinson’s Champions team to raise money in honour of her grandfather, who died of Parkinson’s disease in 2022.

Her mother, Michelle, filmed her smiling and high-fiving at Mile 14 in Queens before heading to the finish line. Her father, tracking her from the family’s Pennsylvania home, texted encouragement at every mile.

At Miles 18 and 19, Rachel replied simply “Ow” and “Ow ow.” She never responded again. Near Mile 24, bystanders and medical personnel attempted to resuscitate her. She was taken to Mount Sinai Medical Centre, where she died that evening.

Rhabdomyolysis is a condition in which the damaged muscles release certain proteins and electrolytes, such as myoglobin, into the blood, leading to various complications including kidney failure, heart arrhythmias, seizures, and eventually death.

Physical stress may lead to rhabdomyolysis, even in healthy and well-conditioned athletes. As per CDC, the symptoms of the condition include severe muscle pain, dark tea or cola colored urine, and severe weakness.

Proper treatment with the administration of fluids usually cures the patients, and people are advised to slowly increase physical activity, stay hydrated, and avoid overheating.

The incident has brought focus to the issue, as five lacrosse players from Tufts University had to be hospitalized due to rhabdomyolysis caused by rigorous training in 2024. Apa was known as a passionate athlete running for a cause.

headline: 'Baseless': PTI rejects reports Imran Khan 'welcomed' suspension of KP govt
subheadline: Restrictions on access to Imran contributed to heightened political tensions, says Gohar
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Gohar strongly rejects reports attributed to Imran.
Says Salman Safdar met PTI founder after months.
PTI chief denies existence of KP forward bloc.

RAWALPINDI: PTI Chairman Barrister Gohar Ali Khan on Tuesday strongly rejected reports that Imran Khan had expressed satisfaction over the end of his party’s government in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, terming the assertion “completely false”.

Speaking to the media in Rawalpindi, Gohar said questions had emerged about Imran’s views on the party, its movement and the situation in KP following Barrister Salman Safdar’s meeting with the incarcerated PTI founder.

“One thing I must strongly refute — which some TV channel ran, claiming Khan Sahib said it was very good that his government ended in KP — that is completely false,” Gohar said.

“Khan sahib never used any such words,” he added.

Gohar said Safdar had informed him that Imran was aware of the emergency and governor’s rule imposed in KP, but maintained that little political discussion took place during the meeting.

He said Safdar had not returned from the meeting with any major political message from the PTI founder.

Safdar met Imran and his wife Bushra Bibi at Adiala jail on Monday following repeated requests for access. The lawyer said the meeting lasted around 40 minutes and covered their health, living conditions and pending legal matters.

Gohar links meeting restrictions to political tensions

Gohar welcomed Safdar’s meeting with Imran, saying restrictions on access to the former premier had contributed to heightened political tensions.

He said Safdar’s meeting was the first such interaction since April 8, after a prolonged period during which access to Imran remained restricted.

The PTI chairman maintained that the political situation could have improved had meetings been allowed, saying matters might not have reached the point of emergency and governor’s rule in KP.

Gohar said the party had made repeated attempts to arrange political meetings with Imran, including seeking access for himself and Senate Opposition Leader Allama Raja Nasir Abbas. When political access could not be secured, efforts were made for Safdar to meet the former premier, he added.

‘No forward bloc in KP’

Addressing speculation about divisions within PTI following the suspension of its provincial government, Gohar said all PTI lawmakers in KP remained with Imran, and there was no forward bloc.

He said any decision would be taken by the PTI founder if such a situation arose.

Gohar also described the disappearance of KP Chief Minister Sohail Afridi and the provincial assembly speaker as “beyond comprehension”, saying the case concerning their recovery had been referred to a larger bench of the Peshawar High Court.

Turning to the broader political situation, Gohar called for a reduction in tensions, saying political forces needed to de-escalate matters for the sake of the country and democracy.

He reiterated the party’s demand for Imran to receive medical treatment and for his personal doctors to be given access to him.

Gohar also said there had been no discussion about shifting the PTI founder either to Bani Gala or to a prison in Islamabad.

article_html:
• Gohar strongly rejects reports attributed to Imran.
  • Says Salman Safdar met PTI founder after months.
  • PTI chief denies existence of KP forward bloc.

RAWALPINDI: PTI Chairman Barrister Gohar Ali Khan on Tuesday strongly rejected reports that Imran Khan had expressed satisfaction over the end of his party’s government in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, terming the assertion “completely false”.

Speaking to the media in Rawalpindi, Gohar said questions had emerged about Imran’s views on the party, its movement and the situation in KP following Barrister Salman Safdar’s meeting with the incarcerated PTI founder.

“One thing I must strongly refute — which some TV channel ran, claiming Khan Sahib said it was very good that his government ended in KP — that is completely false,” Gohar said.

“Khan sahib never used any such words,” he added.

Gohar said Safdar had informed him that Imran was aware of the emergency and governor’s rule imposed in KP, but maintained that little political discussion took place during the meeting.

He said Safdar had not returned from the meeting with any major political message from the PTI founder.

Safdar met Imran and his wife Bushra Bibi at Adiala jail on Monday following repeated requests for access. The lawyer said the meeting lasted around 40 minutes and covered their health, living conditions and pending legal matters.

Gohar links meeting restrictions to political tensions

Gohar welcomed Safdar’s meeting with Imran, saying restrictions on access to the former premier had contributed to heightened political tensions.

He said Safdar’s meeting was the first such interaction since April 8, after a prolonged period during which access to Imran remained restricted.

The PTI chairman maintained that the political situation could have improved had meetings been allowed, saying matters might not have reached the point of emergency and governor’s rule in KP.

Gohar said the party had made repeated attempts to arrange political meetings with Imran, including seeking access for himself and Senate Opposition Leader Allama Raja Nasir Abbas. When political access could not be secured, efforts were made for Safdar to meet the former premier, he added.

‘No forward bloc in KP’

Addressing speculation about divisions within PTI following the suspension of its provincial government, Gohar said all PTI lawmakers in KP remained with Imran, and there was no forward bloc.

He said any decision would be taken by the PTI founder if such a situation arose.

Gohar also described the disappearance of KP Chief Minister Sohail Afridi and the provincial assembly speaker as “beyond comprehension”, saying the case concerning their recovery had been referred to a larger bench of the Peshawar High Court.

Turning to the broader political situation, Gohar called for a reduction in tensions, saying political forces needed to de-escalate matters for the sake of the country and democracy.

He reiterated the party’s demand for Imran to receive medical treatment and for his personal doctors to be given access to him.

Gohar also said there had been no discussion about shifting the PTI founder either to Bani Gala or to a prison in Islamabad.

headline: Prince William to share football outing with Prince George at Barcelona clash
subheadline: Barcelona leaves door open for Prince William’s visit to Camp Nou
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Prince William is set for the excitement of European football tonight to watch his beloved Aston Villa take on Barcelona at the iconic Spotify Camp Nou.

Prince WIlliam together with son Prince George is expected to attend the Champions League clash on Tuesday, November 3, and watch the action from the stadium's presidential box.

The two sides meet for Matchday Four of the Champions League, with kick-off scheduled for 9pm local time.

Read More: Prince George faces new restriction after Archie, Lilibet school change

The Catalan club is prepared to welcome the Prince for the match, although his attendance remains unconfirmed due to scheduling and security arrangements.

Meanwhile, William is said to view his eldest son's break from Eton College as an opportunity to build on the royal education he has been giving him for years.

Rather than relying solely on lessons about the monarchy's past, William wants George to develop a better understanding of the challenges facing the Royal Family today.

According to a source quoted by the National Examiner, the future King has been teaching his son about his eventual responsibilities for some time, but there is now a greater focus on preparing him for the role that lies ahead.

The source claimed he has been discussing current issues within the family and the wider monarchy with George, helping him understand the work involved in supporting the institution.

He has reportedly expressed a wish for him to sit in on some meetings during the holiday.

"George is apparently fascinated by it all," the source added.

Read More: Prince George true feelings laid bare as daunting challenge lies ahead

headline: Justin Timberlake addressing Janet Jackson, Britney Spears drama in new doc
subheadline: The NSYNC frontman is reportedly coming out with a four-part docuseries addressing his biggest scandals
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Justin Timberlake is getting ready to say his piece in a new docuseries.

According to Variety, the Prince of Pop will address some of the biggest scandals in his decades-long career in a new four-part “tell-all” docuseries, set to release on Apple TV+ in December.

One of those scandals is the infamous “wardrobe malfunction” that occurred during Timberlake’s 2004 Super Bowl performance with Janet Jackson, where the NSYNC frontman exposed Jackson’s breast. Although Timberlake has always maintained that it was an accident, Jackson herself will appear in the docuseries to share her side, a source told the outlet.

READ MORE: Britney Spears calls Janet Jackson her 'girl crush' in gushing tribute

Another source claimed that Timberlake will also address some of the recent comments made by his ex-girlfriend Britney Spears, including her bombshell revelations about their relationship in her 2023 memoir The Woman In Me. Spears, 44, and Timberlake, 45, dated from 1999 to 2002, and Spears alleged that she felt pressured by Timberlake to terminate her pregnancy during that time.

Timberlake has not directly addressed Spears’ allegations so far, but the upcoming documentary could finally provide his perspective.

The unnamed docuseries will be directed by Fisher Stevens, who has previously made documentaries about Hollywood legend Carrie Fisher and football icon David Beckham.

READ MORE: Britney Spears' heartbreaking Justin Timberlake breakup revealed

headline: Harry Styles leaves heartbroken fan stunned with unexpected advice
subheadline: Harry Styles stopped the performance to ask a fan about her crush getting engaged
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Harry Styles has left fans talking after giving a heartbroken concertgoer some hopeful advice about her crush.

However, the moment also raised questions about who the fan was really talking about.

During his Harryween show in New York on Saturday, the singer noticed a fan holding a sign that read, “my crush just got engaged”.

He stopped the performance to ask her about it and even wanted to know the man's name.

READ MORE: Harry Styles bids goodbye to NYC residency with grand celebration

The fan, Sofi Subero, felt too nervous to share the name. Harry then joked, “Sounds like you missed the boat on that one! You should have told him. Absolutely heartbreaking.”

He later added, “Well, sometimes people get engaged. Maybe he'll come back around.”

The exchange, however, quickly caught fans' attention, especially because Harry recently got engaged to actress Zoe Kravitz as well, who was watching from the crowd.

This then led many to wonder if Sofi's sign was actually about the singer himself.

READ MORE: Raye enters Hollywood with major star packed project

The couple also sparked massive buzz for their Halloween outfits where Harry performed in huge rat costume, whereas, Zoe wore a white outfit designed to look like a takeaway bag.

headline: Taylor Swift says she's 'not in the business' of stealing jobs from artists
subheadline: The pop megastar, 36, defends succeeding longtime 'Toy Story 5' songwriter Andrew Standton
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Taylor Swift may be ambitious, but she has a strict moral code.

Appearing on a Toy Story 5 Q&A panel in NYC on Sunday, November 1, the pop superstar revealed she made sure she didn’t “kick somebody off” the animated film’s songwriting team for her own shot at the end-credit song.

“I was repeatedly asking, ‘I know that it took me a couple months to come back to this project. Be honest: Did you guys replace me?'” Swift, 36, recalled.

READ MORE: Taylor Swift explains hidden double meanings in 'Toy Story 5' song

The 14-time Grammy winner further emphasised to the filmmakers, “I don’t want to kick somebody off of this project that you reached out to after [me]. I understand, but I’m not in the business of doing that.”

Toy Story 5 director Andrew Standton explained that Swift was his first choice to follow Randy Newman, who has composed music for the franchise since 1995. Even when the singer was unavailable due to her Eras Tour, he chose not to approach another songwriter.

Once Swift finally found some time to commit to the project, the song came together in just hours. Stanton said he was moved by the result, comparing it to hearing Newman perform You’ve Got a Friend in Me for the first time.

READ MORE: Taylor Swift calls 'Eras Tour' the most 'exhausting' tour of her career

headline: UCLA hands Arizona men's basketball its first season-opening loss in 20 years
subheadline: Arizona suffered its first season-opening loss in 20 years, falling 84-75 to UCLA in a Hall of Fame Series game on Monday night
author: Web Desk
article_text:
UCLA beat Arizona on Monday night in Las Vegas, giving the Wildcats their first season-opening loss in 20 years.

Arizona found itself down double digits through the first half of the first game of the 2025-26 NCAA season.

But by halftime, the Arizona team were in front and on their way to a tone-setting win over reigning NCAA champion Florida.

Arizona suffered its first season-opening loss in 20 years, falling 84-75 to UCLA at T-Mobile Arena in a Hall of Fame Series game.

The Wildcats fell behind 14 points midway through the first half and trailed by as many as 16, yet managed to make it a one-point game with just over three minutes to go but couldn't complete the comeback.

UCLA head coach Mike Cronin, in a postgame interview on the TNT broadcast, speaks of his team’s performance, saying, “We’re more athletic than we’ve been. I have not had a bad day coaching this team, and I know that’s hard for everybody to believe out there.”

UCLA will play their first home opener on Thursday night against Cal Poly.

headline: Nicolas Cage left homeless after $10.5 million home disaster
subheadline: Cage still plans to enjoy Halloween with his four-year old-daughter
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Nicolas Cage shared that he is going through a really tough time after a huge sinkhole appeared near his home in Malibu.

The actor was forced to leave his $10.5 million mansion and is now staying in some hotels while the damage is getting handled.

Cage talked about his living situation during L.A. Comic Con on Saturday. When someone asked about his Halloween plans, he explained why he would not be spending night at home.

"I'm currently a little bit homeless," he said, adding that something had happened to his house and he was staying in hotels.

READ MORE: Nicolas Cage recalls scary experience from early acting career

The problem, however. started in September when heavy rain hit Southern California.

A large sinkhole opened near his property and kept getting messier. It first measured around like eight feet but then later reached nearly 30 feet, damaging the driveway while leaving the area unsafe.

The situation was really serious enough for officials to ask people living in 31 nearby homes to leave.

The damaged road also made it difficult for emergency vehicles to reach the area. A gas leak was reported as well, but emergency crews managed to stop it.

READ MORE: Raye enters Hollywood with major star packed project

Despite the trouble, Cage still plans to enjoy Halloween with his four-year old-daughter, August.

headline: When do polls open today? State-by-state breakdown for 2026 midterm elections
subheadline: Polls open across the US as voters decide control of congress
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Voting starts at 5 a.m. ET on Tuesday in Vermont, while most other states will begin to open from 6 to 8 a.m. ET, and in Hawaii, the latest polls open at noon ET. Voting stops as late as 6 p.m. ET in some counties in Indiana and Kentucky and up to 1 a.m. ET in Alaska.

The 2026 mid-term elections in the United States will start on Tuesday, Nov. 3. Millions of Americans are going to the polls to elect their representatives to Congress, which is the key issue for this year.

More than 57 million people voted in advance, and 47 states as well as Washington, D.C. provided opportunities for early voting, except for Alabama, Mississippi, and New Hampshire.

Polling stations opening times by states

Connecticut, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York and Virginia start opening at 6 a.m. ET. North Carolina, Ohio and West Virginia open polls at 6:30 a.m. ET. Delaware, D.C., Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Missouri, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island and South Carolina open polls at 7 a.m.

Polls are opened at 8 a.m. in Alabama, Arizona, Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Mississippi, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas and Wisconsin; in Arkansas - 8:30 a.m.; in Colorado, Montana, Nebraska, New Mexico, North Dakota, Utah and Wyoming - 9 a.m.; in California, Idaho, Nevada and Oregon - 10 a.m.; in Alaska and Washington - 11 a.m.; and Hawaii - at noon.

Polls closing time

The first to be closed will be those in eastern Indiana and Kentucky - 6 p.m. ET; Georgia, South Carolina, Vermont and Virginia - 7 p.m. ET; North Carolina, Ohio and West Virginia - 7:30 p.m. ET; most of the Northeast and Midwest - 8 p.m. ET; Arizona, Colorado, Kansas, Louisiana, Michigan, Minnesota, New Mexico, New York, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas and Wisconsin - 9 p.m. ET; California, Idaho, Oregon and Washington - 11 p.m. ET; Hawaii - midnight ET; and Alaska - 1 a.m. ET.

Things to consider before voting

All persons lining up at the time when polling ends have the right to complete the voting process. Requirements for voter IDs depend on the state. The mail ballots should be sent out and postmarked on Election Day, and many states provide the possibility to track your ballot.

Polling locations can be found with the help of the local registrar, Vote.org, and the National Association of Secretaries of State. Voters can even vote with a provisional ballot despite any disputes about registration.

headline: Olivia Rodrigo earns huge songwriter honour for 'yspsfagsil' album
subheadline: Olivia Rodrigo achieves new milestone for third album 'you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love'
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Olivia Rodrigo is announced as the Songwriter of the Year for this year's Variety's Hitmaker awards for her album, you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love.

The 23-year-old pop superstar released her third studio album this June, and it became the highlight of the year for music enthusiasts.

While the drivers license hitmaker has earned much critical acclaim and several milestones on the streaming charts, the new accolade will celebrate her talent for songwriting.

READ MORE: Olivia Rodrigo surprises fans with new music announcement amid tour

The ceremony will be held in December and fans cannot wait for Rodrigo to receive the award.

They took to X and wrote, "Omgg her 2nd award in the same category. WOOHOO! Very much deserved!" and "AS SHE SHOULD I’m sooo proud of her!!!"

A third chimed in, "Well deserved," and "The year of Olivia… or decade may be?" while one declared, "voice of this generation indeed."

More added, "OMG LET'S GO LEGEND!!" and "cigarette smoke did that!!!"

headline: How did Jesus de Miguel die? Everything to know about fatal collision with Jesus Owono
subheadline: Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel dies at 30 after on-field collision
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Jesus de Miguel died after suffering a cardiac arrest in a collision with FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono during Monday’s LaLiga 2 match, and was pronounced dead at 8:00 a.m. local time on Tuesday. He was 30.

The incident occurred in the seventh minute of stoppage time with the score tied 2-2. Owono rushed out of his area all the way to midfield to challenge for a long ball that De Miguel, the Tenerife forward, was trying to reach.

The two collided heavily, and De Miguel went down. Owono was immediately shown a red card for “making a sudden, high-kicking tackle on an opponent using excessive force whilst the ball was in play.”

The match was suspended as medical staff treated De Miguel, who was taken by ambulance to hospital and admitted to intensive care. Owono, walking off after his red card, turned around and joined other players rushing to check on De Miguel.

Tenerife said Monday night the player was “stable, given the seriousness of the condition,” but early Tuesday reported his condition had “deteriorated neurologically.”

The club then confirmed his death.

The Spanish Football Federation suspended all activity Tuesday, November 3, including Copa del Rey and Copa de la Reina matches, and cancelled the presentation of Spain Under-21s’ fixture against Japan.

All UEFA competition matches this week will be preceded by a moment of silence.

headline: Sabrina Carpenter sparks theories with return to the studio: 'SC8?'
subheadline: Sabrina Carpenter drops cryptic clues for new music amid hiatus
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Sabrina Carpenter released Man's Best Friend in 2025 and fans have been asking for new music and tour announcement all of this year, while the pop icon took a break.

However, it appears that the Sharpest Tool hitmaker might be gearing up to grant fans' wishes soon as she dropped some clues hinting at new music.

As Carpenter took to Instagram to share pictures from her Halloween celebration, she included one which showed a skeleton with a blonde wig placed against a recording mic.

Fans on social media took that as a clue to her return to the studio, and thus, new music in the near future.

READ MORE: Sabrina Carpenter turns heads in daring blue gown at star-studded gala

Flocking to X, one fan exclaimed, "UMMMM SHE WAS IN THE STU ?????" while another agreed, "It’s a sign."

A third chimed in, "Can’t wait I’m so excited," and "You might just be onto something," wrote another.

More theorised, "i see the vision," and "maybe im reaching but i kinda think she actually is teasing new music idkkkk."

headline: Prince William grabs British actor by shoulders in surprising nightclub clash
subheadline: Prince William plays unlikely peacemaker during wild night out in London
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Prince William once stepped in to stop a fight involving actor Will during a night out in London.

The Coronation Street star has recalled how the future King came to his rescue during an evening at Boujis, the exclusive private members’ club in Kensington.

Speaking to Fearne Cotton on her Happy Place podcast, the 50 year old revealed that he was getting around on crutches after injuring himself while playing football.

Despite the injury, he was enjoying himself and was surprised to find himself standing next to Prince William when he went to the club's toilets.

Read More: Prince William to share football outing with George at Barcelona clash

The pair later found themselves on the dance floor, Will said someone shoulder-barged him off his crutches, while others nearby stood laughing at him.

Furious at being knocked over, the actor launched himself at the man and admitted he was ready for a fight.

But before the confrontation could escalate, someone stepped in and grabbed him by the shoulders.

Recounting the moment, Will told Fearne: "I've got these hands on me shoulders picking me up and I'm sort of doing what I do.

And then I hear this person going, Leave it, Will. He's not worth it. Leave it."

"And it was Prince William, and he's got his hands on my shoulders, looking at me now, going, 'Will, leave it. He's not worth it.'"

His protection officers soon arrived, and the actor was eventually escorted out of the club.

The star recalled how a friend rang him the following day, amused by what he had witnessed.

He said: "This is the funny part of this story: I go home the next day, and my mate phones me and goes, 'I'll never forget seeing William with his hands on your shoulders, like he was one of your mates.'"

headline: CM Maryam seeks Rs5bn in damages from ally Salik over Punjab corruption claims
subheadline: Legal notice seeks retraction, apology over federal minister’s remarks within seven days
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Maryam asks Salik to substantiate corruption allegations.
Federal minister maintains corruption occurring in Punjab.
Salik denies seeking appointment of Gujrat DC.

Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz has sought Rs5 billion in damages from federal minister and political ally Chaudhry Salik Hussain over his allegations of corruption in Punjab, according to a legal notice served on the minister.

The six-page notice, issued on Maryam’s behalf by Additional Advocate General Punjab Chaudhry Muhammad Nawaz, relates to remarks made by Salik during an interview with a private television channel on November 2.

Salik had said he did not possess evidence but heard stories about corruption in Punjab every day, as per the notice. He further remarked that corruption-related files had filled “entire cupboards” in the province, the notice mentioned.

The notice disputes the assertions, maintaining that Salik had failed to identify any document, official inquiry, audit observation, investigation, complaint or other verifiable source to substantiate his remarks.

It calls upon the recipients to withdraw the disputed allegations and publish an “unconditional and unequivocal apology and clarification” with prominence equivalent to that given to the original remarks.

The notice also seeks removal or correction of the disputed portions of the interview and related material, besides demanding Rs5 billion in damages over what it describes as harm caused to the chief minister’s reputation.

The recipients have been given seven days to comply with the demands, failing which the chief minister could initiate legal proceedings, including under the Punjab Defamation Act, 2024.

Maryam had challenged Salik to present evidence

The legal notice follows a public exchange between Maryam and Salik over his remarks about corruption in the provincial administration.

Addressing a ceremony in Attock earlier, the chief minister challenged the federal minister to produce evidence supporting his assertions and warned that she would take him to court if he failed to do so.

“You are a federal minister. Don’t make allegations, present evidence,” Maryam had said.

She also linked Salik’s criticism to the appointment of the deputy commissioner in Gujrat, saying he was unhappy because an officer of his choice had not been posted to the district.

Salik subsequently stood by his remarks, maintaining that corruption was taking place in Punjab.

“I stand by my statement. Corruption is taking place in Punjab,” he said.

The federal minister also rejected Maryam’s assertion about the Gujrat deputy commissioner’s appointment, saying he had not sought the posting of any particular officer and that a DC was already serving in the district.

headline: Is Election Day 2026 a federal holiday? Here's what open and closed on November 3
subheadline: US banks to operate normally on election day
author: Web Desk
article_text:
No, Election Day is not a federal holiday. Therefore, banks, stock exchanges, postal services, and most businesses will be working on November 3, when Americans vote in the last midterm elections of the second term of President Donald Trump.

What is open on Election Day?

Stock exchanges (New York Stock Exchange, NASDAQ), bond markets, and most banks will work according to their usual schedule.

The postal service will be working and delivering mail; UPS and FedEx will also be working, delivering and picking up packages and operating stores as usual. Major chains of supermarkets and other shops will be working.

What states have a holiday on Election Day?

Each state, not the federal government, regulates the status of Election Day. Five states, including Illinois, Hawaii, Maryland, New York, and West Virginia, have a public holiday on Election Day.

In which states must employers allow paid time off to vote?

There are fifteen states, including Alaska, Arizona, California, Colorado, Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, Nevada, New Mexico, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, and Wyoming, that mandate paid time off to vote on Election Day even though the day is not a public holiday in any of these states.

Ohio recognizes Election Day as a holiday from noon to 5:30 p.m., and employers are required to allow an appropriate amount of time off to vote, but state government operations remain open.

headline: Oscar winner Michael Douglas looks back on secret romance with co-star
subheadline: In his memoir, Douglas shared how he would spend time with Kathleen Turner after filming
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Michael Douglas has finally opened up about a romance with Kathleen Turner that remained a secret for four years.

The actor revealed that their feelings for each other grew while they were working on the 1984 film Romancing the Stone in Mexico.

At the time, Douglas was separated from his wife, Diandra Luker. He has now admitted that he and Turner became more than just co-stars but tried hard to keep their relationship away from the public eye.

READ MORE: Michael Douglas explains why success should not be dismissed as family privilege

In his memoir, One Helluva Ride, Douglas shared how they used to spend time together after filming. He, however, also recalled secretly visiting Turner's hotel room at night, when everyone else go to sleep.

Their romance came to an end after Diandra visited Mexico with their son Cameron. She became suspicious about the two and Douglas said they decided to end things after her visit.

The Hollywood icon, moreover, later returned to his wife but admitted that their marriage was never the same again.

READ MORE: Raye enters Hollywood with major star packed project

Now, Douglas is using his experience to warn young actors about dating their co-stars. He believes things can become very uncomfortable when a relationship ends but both actors still have to work together.

Turner also reacted to the revelation, saying, "I love Michael, and I look forward to enjoying the book."

headline: FIFA boss Infantino accused of using Trump ties to secure US work permit for undocumented maid
subheadline: There is no public finding that the permit was improperly issued or that Infantino or Cordeiro broke the law
author: Web Desk
article_text:
FIFA president Gianni Infantino allegedly asked an adviser with connections to US President Donald Trump's administration to secure a work permit for his family's housekeeper after she lost her legal authorization to work in the country.

The allegations, reported by the New York Post on Tuesday, November 3, come as Trump's administration continues to tighten immigration rules for foreign nationals living and working in the United States.

According to leaked documents and three sources familiar with the matter, Infantino's Nicaraguan housekeeper, Yajarlin del Socorro Fernandez, remained on FIFA's payroll for months after her work authorisation was revoked in June 2025.

An internal FIFA employment letter reportedly confirmed that Fernandez worked full-time for the football governing body's American division from August 2024 until October 2025.

The 33-year-old had initially received permission to work under a humanitarian parole programme, which the Trump administration subsequently terminated for several nationalities, including Nicaraguans.

However, she received a fresh work permit in January 2026.

The newspaper alleged that Infantino sought assistance from Carlos Cordeiro, a former FIFA official who was appointed to Trump's White House World Cup task force in May 2025.

Cordeiro reportedly used his government connections to help Fernandez obtain new immigration authorization.

The report also alleged that an incorrect residential address had been used in her earlier immigration paperwork.

Immigration lawyer Michael Wildes, who previously represented First Lady Melania Trump, told the newspaper that securing a new permit under such circumstances would be highly unusual for an ordinary applicant.

However, there is no public finding that the permit was improperly issued or that Infantino or Cordeiro broke the law.

FIFA, Infantino and US immigration authorities did not respond to the newspaper's questions. Cordeiro said he was unaware of the story.

The allegations emerge amid growing scrutiny of Infantino's leadership ahead of FIFA's presidential election in March 2027.

headline: Olivia Rodrigo teases new present with 'take me home (4 christmas)' song
subheadline: Olivia Rodrigo gives fans a glimpse into special Christmas project ahead of release
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Olivia Rodrigo is about to release her first ever Christmas song, take me home (4 christmas), but there is more to this surprise release than fans expected.

The 23-year-old pop superstar is also releasing a companion music video, featuring the Sex and the City star Cynthia Nixon and Saturday Night Live’s Ben Marshall.

The song and the music video both will be released on Thursday, November 5, and fans could not contain their excitement at the announcement.

READ MORE: Olivia Rodrigo surprises fans with new music announcement amid tour

Flocking to X, fans reacted to the news, writing, "OMGGG. wait. cynthia nixon?! snl's ben marshall?! this is gonna be EPIC," and "BEN MARSHALL!!!!!!!!"

A third chimed in, "another music video??? omfg this girl is WORKING," and "OH MY GOD??!" wrote another.

Others had similar reactions as they wrote, "WHAT OMG?? WE ARE GETTING MIRANDA IN THIS WTH??" and "WE WON SO BAD OMG."

While someone declared, "no one has had a better era this year.. that aoty is HERS."

article_text:
Meghan Markle has allegedly urged Prince Harry to finally take charge of the royal mess he once promised would never happen, rubbing salt into the Duke's wounds.

Harry is said to have been left heartbroken after being snubbed by King Charles as the Sussexes were expecting a warm welcome from the monarch on their return to Britain.

Contrary to the Duke's wishes, he was sidelined instead of being embraced by the monarch. Now, the Duchess is said to be taking a much firmer stance.

READ MORE: Who forced Meghan Markle to stay silent?

According to an insider close to the couple, Meghan already knew this would happen and had told her husband to leave no stone unturned to achieve excellence.

However, she is now exhausted by the never-ending cycle of royal drama and rejection. She feels Harry's pain but wants him to finally admit the truth and take responsibility.

Meghan's message to him is clear: "own the decision instead of living with regret."

Harry was sure and confident that he would mend the fractured family ties, but he failed to do so.

Now Meghan wants him to step up, lead from the front, and stop expecting the Palace to make the first move.

The Duchess has reportedly changed her stance and wants to end the royal rift and find a way forward rather than reliving the same painful snub all over again.
